# 51 rules shaped like a typical agent hardening policy (deny beats allow,
# write default deny). From the file hooks spike; the secrets directory name is
# neutral here.
allow write /work/**
allow write /tmp/**
allow write /root/.cache/**
allow write /var/tmp/**
allow write /home/*/workspace/**
allow write /run/app/**
deny rw **/.claude/**
deny rw **/.aws/**
deny rw **/.ssh/**
deny rw **/.gnupg/**
deny rw **/.kube/**
deny rw **/.docker/**
deny rw **/.azure/**
deny rw **/.config/gcloud/**
deny rw /home/*/.aws/**
deny rw /root/.aws/**
deny rw /root/.ssh/**
deny rw /var/run/secrets/example.io/serviceaccount/**
deny rw /run/secrets/example.io/serviceaccount/**
deny read /etc/shadow
deny read /etc/gshadow
deny write /etc/passwd
deny write /etc/group
deny write /etc/sudoers
deny write /etc/sudoers.d/**
deny write /etc/cron.d/**
deny write /etc/crontab
deny write /var/spool/cron/**
deny write /etc/systemd/**
deny write /etc/profile.d/**
deny write /etc/ld.so.preload
deny write /etc/ld.so.conf.d/**
deny write **/.bashrc
deny write **/.bash_profile
deny write **/.profile
deny write **/.zshrc
deny write **/.git/config
deny write **/.git/hooks/**
deny write **/.npmrc
deny write **/.pypirc
deny write **/.netrc
deny read **/id_rsa
deny read **/id_ed25519
deny write /usr/lib/python3/**
deny write /usr/local/lib/python3.11/**
deny write /usr/lib/node_modules/**
deny write /usr/local/bin/**
deny write /usr/bin/**
deny write /work/.claude/settings.json
deny write /work/CLAUDE.md
deny write /work/.mcp.json
